CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 08 / 12

Production possibilities frontier (PPF)

Moving versus shifting a PPF沿線與移線

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Trace movements along the PPF versus shifts in the frontier. Show how a change in resources or good-specific technology affects production possibilities.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

沿 PPF 移動是既有資源重新分配；資源增加或技術進步令邊界外移。若只改善 X 技術，最大 Y 未必改變。

A movement along the frontier reallocates existing resources. More resources or better technology can shift it outward. A technology improvement limited to X may raise its intercept while leaving the maximum Y unchanged.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Better computer technology raises possible computer output at many allocations; choosing more computers on the old frontier is simply reallocation. 技術進步與重新分配不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Only X technology improves. What may happen? 只有 X 技術改善？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
